from.place: proof: a section vanishing on the closed fibre over a valuation ring already vanishes modulo a nonzero element of the maximal ideal

title: Vanishing on the closed fibre over a valuation ring descends to some A/pi
statement: Let A be a valuation ring with maximal ideal \mathfrak m, let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) be of finite presentation [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let X_0 be the closed fibre, let L be an invertible module on X [def-sc-invertible-module], and let s\in\Gamma(X,L) with s|_{X_0}=0. Then there is a nonzero \pi\in\mathfrak m such that s restricts to zero on X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}\operatorname{Spec}(A/\pi).
